raw_cycle_rederivation.reason_old_ratio_differs: M1040 adds the frozen M1016 matched common-service merge and uses a different zero/bit denominator; it is a new raw CPU coordinate, not a promotion of M528.

packing_first_principles.finding: The nonzero conflicts are real port-calendar witnesses for the frozen schedule, but the source implementation is not a generally valid global collision proof: it retains only the last appended cycle per macro group while task intervals can overlap, and its row argument is unused. M1051 independently sorts every macro-group/cycle event and happens to recover the same 403922 excess accesses for this trace. The reported lifetime values remain task-local and address-blind.
packing_first_principles.interpretation: The current paired-psum 1RW schedule is not executable as reported and therefore cannot support the 214912-byte packing. This does not prove that 214912 bytes is fundamentally impossible: an explicit conflict-aware scheduler, bank remap, extra port, or extra bank can repair it, but cycles/capacity must then be recomputed.

findings.finding: 403922 psum 1RW excess accesses are outside the raw cycle recurrence
findings.impact: 434242823 cycles and 1.734207867x are conflict-unrepaired CPU opportunities, not executable matched-cycle speedups and not pairable with the 214912-byte storage point.
Its number is independently validated for this one trace, but the implementation cannot serve as a reusable global packing/lifetime proof.

minimum_repair.preferred: Add an exact psum group/address port calendar to the matched-service merger; schedule all overlapping tasks globally, explicitly consume or hide every collision, then recompute candidate and both baseline completion cycles under the same policy.
required_checks: one operation per packed 1RW macro group per cycle
logical bank and row address included in lifetime and overwrite checks
same rescheduling policy and storage ports for candidate, strongest-zero, and bit
240-KiB capacity recomputed after any bank duplication or port change
no arithmetic speedup promotion until conflict-aware cycles and an RTL boundary agree
minimum_repair.serialization_rule: Use a fixed deterministic 1RW queue/port arbitration policy and propagate every delayed read/write into task readiness, downstream work start, completion, and sample commit. cycles+403922 is explicitly prohibited because idle-slot hiding and cascaded stalls are both possible.
minimum_repair.capacity_distinction: The byte sum may remain below 240 KiB while its selected packed port organization is infeasible. Report capacity_bytes_pass and port_feasibility_pass as separate gates.
minimum_repair.fallback: Keep psum and weight as identical external common charges and cite only the C1 component implementation plus the raw CPU opportunity in a separate modeling table.

claim_boundary.legal: Frozen H67 four-Conv, 51.84M-row CPU model: equal logical common-service counts and parent conservation; conflict-unrepaired candidate 434242823 raw cycles versus 753067320 for either baseline, or 1.734207867x raw opportunity. The paired-psum packing audit finds 403922 excess 1RW accesses and fails its capacity gate.
illegal: throughput/mm2 paired with the component DC area
